title: External sandboxes for coding agents
author: Simon Willison
organization: Simon Willison's Weblog (work done with Prime Radiant)
what_changed: Simon and Prime Radiant introduce the 'external sandbox' pattern and release three open-source sandbox server implementations that coding agents (Pi, Claude Code, Codex) can call to execute code.
mechanism: The agent process lives outside the sandbox; only code it wants to execute is sent over a common localhost API to a dedicated sandbox server. Optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy controls which hosts executed code can reach, reconfigurable live via a UI; a credential-replacement mechanism lets sandboxed code make authenticated API calls without the secret ever being shared with the agent.
